title: Tricks, Blessings and Storms
notes: The Rogue's new tree, Dirty Tricks: on-hit tricks. A hidden second stab (twice as likely on a crit), thrown knives at other enemies, smoke that blinds, caltrops that slow and bleed, and pickpocketing for gold. Twist the Knife makes your crits roll every trick twice; tricks can poison and add Lethality. Its Limit Break, Death by a Thousand Cuts, tears an enemy open after 10 tricks.

The Holy Knight's new tree, The Gods' Blessings: one on-hit blessing for each living god. Celmiss heals you and your allies, Gaeliel calls lightning, Cevel judges (double against enemies with more life than you), Gulthus drains life and raises a striking spirit from what it kills, Mvrow's spirit beast bites, Lifius grows a healing flower, Delthius rolls one of your other blessings, Kryuleiza opens a rift, and Obliveion strips a buff and deals Null. The Pantheon (Limit Break) sets them all off at once. Blessings stay separate from prayers and Favor.

The Mage's new tree, Spellstorm: on-CAST effects that roll whenever you cast a damaging spell, likelier for bigger spells. Arcane Echo, Mana Surge, Elemental Overflow, Ley Line, Spell Mirror, Orbiting Runes, Time Slip, Prismatic Burst and Overcast (Limit Break: the spell again at full power). Most take a passive slot, the same slots as your familiars: storm or familiars. Its capstone, Spellstorm, rolls everything twice for free.
Each new tree has its route on the Tree of Life with three Crowns, and chains 1 or 2 links (the Sollari still go deepest). On-hit gear joins these chains too.
The skill window's passive row now shows "Always on: N" (hover it for the list), so a class with many True passives no longer squeezes the window.
